faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions from our patients.
faq.items.q1: How do I book a consultation?
faq.items.a1: You can book a consultation by phone (+82-2-797-2773), KakaoTalk, or through our online reservation form. Let us know your preferred date and time, and we'll confirm your appointment.
faq.items.q2: How long does a treatment take?
faq.items.a2: Treatment duration varies: Ultherapy Prime takes about 60-90 minutes, Thermage about 30-60 minutes, and Botox/Filler about 15-30 minutes. You'll receive detailed information during your consultation.
faq.items.q3: Can I return to daily activities after treatment?
faq.items.a3: Most non-surgical treatments allow same-day return to daily activities. Some temporary swelling or bruising may occur depending on the treatment area, but typically resolves within 1-2 weeks.
faq.items.a4: Prices vary based on treatment area, scope, and products used. Accurate pricing can be provided through a personalized consultation tailored to your needs.
faq.items.a5: Yes, underground parking is available in the building. Treatment customers receive 2 hours of free parking.
faq.items.q6: How should I prepare for treatment?
faq.items.a6: No special preparation is required. However, please come with light or no makeup on the treatment day. Specific pre-treatment instructions may be provided for certain procedures.
faq.items.a7: Yes, consultations are available in English, Japanese, and Chinese. Please let us know if you need interpretation services when booking your appointment.
faq.items.q8: Do you use only genuine equipment?
faq.items.a8: LIV Plastic Surgery is an officially certified Ultherapy Prime and Thermage clinic, using only 100% genuine equipment and products. Authenticity certificates are available for all products.
